Native / Host: additional observations, not ground truth
Saved session / receipt association → paired244 · same device
Check actual versions, units and field states; same phase ≠ atomic synchronization
Association IDs are provenance, not detection features
Not training; not a blind test
T: alarm F: no alarm U: cannot judge
F is not a device-safety claim
Counts describe catalogues; not all fields are used, available or required to agree.
Solid: implemented flow Dashed: tested / unintegrated Accepted: current selected method
